_comment: S8 discernment provisioning (Trust Layer — ADR-013 §4/§6). Copy to discernment.config.json (same directory; or point SAGE_GATE1_DISCERNMENT_CONFIG at a path) and fill in the operator's taxonomy. PRESENCE of a parseable config + the consult credential = the discernment surface is ON (the S2 derive-from-provisioning precedent; SAGE_GATE1_DISCERNMENT_ENABLED=false force-disables). The server side stays DARK until SUBSTRATE_TRUST_CORE_ENABLED is set — un-flipped, the hooks fail open with honest logs and zero spend. All discernment/L4/intervention outputs are MEASURE (advisory); ENFORCE is S11.
_credential_binding: REQUIRED: the CONSULT credential (SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL) that carries the spawn + hand-back POSTs must be minted with its agent_id EQUAL to orchestrator_profile.agentId below. The server 403s any other credential (it must never write another agent's delegation record). A NULL-agent or mismatched consult credential makes every spawn 403 — the frame still injects (fail-open) but NO collaboration record, L4 audit, or trust event is ever produced; look for 'DISCERN-OUTAGE … http 403' in gate1.log. This is separate from SAGE_GATE1_ACCRED_CREDENTIAL + SAGE_GATE1_AGENT_ID, which govern the H4 accreditation write path.

orchestrator_profile.purpose: OPTIONAL but recommended (S9b G1a calling gate): the loop's declared standing purpose — orients every session's opening examination; absent, the harness logs CALLING-GATE purposeless and injects the calling elicitation (measure mode).

profile.purpose: search and summarize the repository for the requesting user
